purpose: Calibration only; no full scientific trajectory launched
notes: GD matches the official MLP/MSE demonstration; Adam LR is an exploratory proposal, not matched GD step magnitude.
Adam betas 0.9/0.99 and epsilon 1e-7 match the official adaptive-EOS README example, rather than its script beta2 default 0.995.
LA selects largest algebraic eigenvalues; original released utilities default to largest magnitude (LM). Both options are available.
Test loss and accuracy cover all 10000 standard test images; test data are not used for stopping.
No clipping, LR schedule, augmentation, additive gradient noise or weight decay.
